name: Tablet Mode
author: Andrei Yurik
description: Makes tablet mode work on a 2-in-1: the screen follows the accelerometer, the touchscreen and pen follow the screen, the built-in keyboard goes quiet while folded and an on-screen keyboard plugin comes up. The bar button appears once folded, to lock the rotation

barWidget.description: Shows up once the machine is folded. Tap it to lock the rotation, turn the screen by hand, or show and hide the on-screen keyboard. Middle-click turns the screen.

schema.label: Which way the screen turns
schema.description: How the accelerometer is mounted. Standard is right for almost every machine. If the screen turns the wrong way, pick the pair that comes out mirrored: portrait-swapped for the two upright positions, landscape-swapped for the two flat ones, rotated-180 when everything is upside down.

schema.label: Always show the button
schema.description: Off keeps the button out of the bar until the machine is folded. On keeps it there in laptop mode too.

schema.label: Show the on-screen keyboard when folded
schema.description: With an on-screen keyboard plugin enabled (On-Screen Keyboard or Omaqwerty from plugins.omarchy.org), folding the machine brings it up and opening it puts it away again. A keyboard opened by hand is left alone.
